Subject: [unmarked] PhD Position on HM of camera trap data in Norway
 
Dear unmarked users,

We are proposing a PhD thesis spanning 3 to 4 years, to be conducted at the University of South-Eastern Norway under the supervision of a multinational team from Norway, Poland, and Spain. The selected candidate will undertake the challenge of developing hierarchical modeling solutions aimed at ensuring robust inference in occupancy modeling. This involves addressing the complexities of data affected by imperfect detection, primarily from camera trapping, as well as imperfect classification arising from citizen science and artificial intelligence.

For further details and access to the application portal, please visit here.

PhD start date: 1st June 2024

Application deadline: 1st March 2024

Simone

--
*** Three hierarchical modeling email lists ***
(1) unmarked (this list): for questions specific to the R package unmarked
(2) SCR: for design and Bayesian or non-bayesian analysis of spatial capture-recapture
(3) HMecology: for everything else, especially material covered in the books by Royle & Dorazio (2008), Kéry & Schaub (2012), Kéry & Royle (2016, 2021) and Schaub & Kéry (2022)
